title: The Euphrates
lead: The great river of Mesopotamia: one of the four rivers of Eden (Genesis 2:14), the far border of the land promised to Abraham (Genesis 15:18) and the edge of the power of David and Solomon (2 Samuel 8:3; 1 Kings 4:21). Babylon stood on it, and in Revelation armies and kings come from beyond it (Revelation 9:14; Revelation 16:12).
